headline: How To Get Wisptis
title: Wisptis | Night spawn and evolution | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Looking for Wisptis in Aniimo? It is a Dark Aniimo that only appears at night in Berylline Vale, in the forest beside the Bloom. If it is daytime, change the time from the functions menu. To evolve it, reach level twenty nine, then defeat three Wisptis of your own form in a row. Spend a Night Stone and you get Ignitis. Will you hunt Wisptis tonight? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Beat three Wisptis in a row

description: Aniimo: Wisptis spawns at night in the Berylline Vale forest by the Bloom; reach level 29, beat three Wisptis in a row and use a Night Stone for Ignitis.
